[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided breakfast options:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Overnight Oats: Mix rolled oats, milk, nuts, seeds, and fruits in a jar and refrigerate overnight.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Scrambled Egg Muffins: Whisk eggs, add diced veggies and cheese, pour into muffin tin, and bake.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Avocado Toast: Toast whole-grain bread, mash avocado, and add a fried egg or tomato.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided lunch and dinner options:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Salad Jars: Layer mixed greens, veggies, proteins, and vinaigrette in a jar.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Quinoa or Brown Rice Bowls: Cook quinoa or brown rice and top with roasted veggies and lean proteins.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Lentil or Veggie Soup: Cook a large batch and portion into containers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Grilled Chicken or Fish with Roasted Veggies: Marinate and grill chicken or fish with roasted veggies.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Mason Jar Meals: Layer cooked rice, beans, and veggies in a jar with a protein source.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided snack options:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Fresh Fruit and Nuts: Prepare a container with fresh fruit and nuts.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Energy Balls: Mix rolled oats, nuts, seeds, and dried fruits to create energy balls.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Yogurt Parfait: Layer Greek yogurt, fresh berries, and granola in a container.
